notes:
ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) used for robots.txt (permissive, no Claude-agent disallow) and the category sitemap XML (SitemapFiles/PKUK/sitemap-*-category-0.xml); direct HTTP on category pages returned only an empty client-rendered SuiteCommerce Advanced shell (5.9KB, title 'Shopping',
), so escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless (chromium, wait_until=networkidle). All ~35 category pages rendered cleanly under Playwright with no 403/DataDome/CAPTCHA block encountered at any point, so tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was never needed (unlike sister site PB Kids US/SR5 which hit a 403 wall - this UK site behaved differently). TREE: union of the category sitemap + each category page's own 'Hide Filters' left-nav subcategory list (Searchspring-powered) + facet panels, cross-checked against the rendered h1/breadcrumb on every leaf visited. QTY: exact 'N products' / 'X - Y of Z products' text rendered on each category page after JS hydration, read from the live DOM. EXCLUDED and why: all-baby-bed-linen, all-kids-bed-linen, all-bath, all-decor (parent/aggregate 'All X' listings excluded per parent-category-URL rule since each has real sibling subcategories); uni-baby-bed-linen (broken/retired slug - renders identical h1 'All Baby Bed Linen' and identical qty=144 to all-baby-bed-linen, i.e. silently serves the parent's number, canonical mismatch); rugs/curtains/all-curtains-curtain-rods (sitemap-listed URL returns live HTTP 404 'Oops! something is wrong here'; 'All Curtains & Curtain Rods' exists only as an in-page facet filter on /rugs with no live dedicated URL, so not recorded per no-URL-invention rule - this site has no valid Curtains textile node); christmas/christmas-shop-category/stockings and .../xmas-bed-linen (both slugs render an unrelated 'Seasonal Clearance' page, identical h1 and identical qty=43 to each other - broken/retired nodes, not recorded); all-pyjamas (apparel, out of scope); furniture/desk-study-furniture/kids-bookcases and storage-wall-systems (explicitly under the /furniture/ path - Furniture.xlsx territory, not touched, excluded from Storage per storage-furniture-boundary rule); decor/decor-by-category/shelving 'Shelving & Hooks' (page tagline 'Shelving that's perfect for displaying photos, trinkets or books' confirms decorative display shelving, not a storage/organization function - left to Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories); decor/decor-by-category/canopies 'Canopies & Hanging Decor' (fabric bed canopies bundled with generic hanging decor under a non-bedding-specific site category, not covered by textile.md's inclusion list - left to Decorative Home Accessories); backpacks-study/study-accessories/all-study-accessories (29 products dominated by Table & Task Lamps and decorative Shelving/Pinboards, no genuine storage/organizer items - excluded); all backpack/lunch-bag/changing-bag nodes (personal carrying bags, not home storage, excluded per storage bag boundary); all lighting/mirror/pinboard/cot-mobile/coin-bank/wall-art-decor nodes and all Furniture/Baby-toy/Gift/Sale-collection/Best-seller/Buying-guide nodes (out of scope per both rule files or excluded as View-All/Collection/promotional pages). LOW-confidence: bath/bath-by-category/bathroom-accessories included in Storage at LOW confidence - page shows 7 products with facet breakdown Type: 'Bins & Baskets' (4, laundry hampers e.g. 'Palmer Scalloped Hamper') and 'Bathroom Accessories' (2, unclear type); majority of visible SKUs are storage hampers/baskets but the site names the page generically, so flagged for manual review rather than dropped or given HIGH confidence.
